items.title: Edwards Lifesciences (EW) Trial Win Puts Fair Value Back In Focus
items.summary: Edwards Lifesciences (EW) is back in focus after new data showed its PASCAL tricuspid repair system outperformed medical therapy in the CLASP II TR trial, with benefits sustained through one year. Recent data and regulatory milestones have come alongside clear momentum in the Edwards Lifesciences share price, with a 1-month share price return of 11.79% and a 1-year total shareholder return of 13.12% on a closing share price of US$95.19 as of 4 November 2026.
